scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages/guten-bubble.pot --domain=guten-bubble --include=dist,guten-bubble.php --skip-php && wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages/guten-bubble-admin.pot --domain=guten-bubble-admin --exclude=dist,legacy,src --skip-js
scripts.i18n:po: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages/guten-bubble.pot wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages/guten-bubble-ja.po && wp-env run cli -- wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages/guten-bubble-admin.pot wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages/guten-bubble-admin-ja.po
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/guten-bubble/languages --no-purge
scripts.i18n:update: yarn build && yarn i18n:pot && yarn i18n:po
scripts.package: yarn build && rm -f guten-bubble.zip && zip -rq guten-bubble.zip guten-bubble -x 'guten-bubble/src/*' 'guten-bubble/assets/*' '*.DS_Store'
scripts.svn:copy: yarn build && rsync -a --delete --exclude=.svn --exclude=src --exclude=assets --exclude=.DS_Store guten-bubble/ svn/guten-bubble/trunk/ && rsync -a --delete --exclude=.svn --exclude=.DS_Store guten-bubble/assets/ svn/guten-bubble/assets/
